venues.name: CC Atlanta
venues.narrative: **CCATL — Sunday 8/30.** Close Company Atlanta is closed on Sundays; no EON report is submitted. Dark day, not an outstanding report.

venues.name: CC Nashville
venues.narrative: **CCNSH Sunday 8/30 — MOD: KE, JMS.** Net sales $1,779 vs target $1,306 (+36.2%). ~57 guests, $31.21 check avg, comps $39.30 (2.2% — normal industry night plus a Wray & Nephew taste for a curious first-timer). Food $80. Very slow start — only ~$350 in sales from 4-8:30pm, then ~$1,400 between 9pm and close, most of it in about 90 minutes. Good large groups: a bridal celebration who loved the Jojos and Wings, and a ~10-person Four Seasons crew who said they try something new off the menu every visit. Danny updated orders ahead of tomorrow's inventory count. Needs: CO2. Favorite moment: regular Brody declaring CC his favorite spot in town.

venues.name: D&C Denver
venues.narrative: **DVR Sunday 8/30 — AM MOD: MJH; PM MOD: Carey & Rachel.** Net sales $9,289.98 vs target $10,392 (-10.6%). 151 guests (Tock), comps $237 (2.56%). DC/AM $1,429.24, D&C PM $7,860.74, Garden/6A $1,651.09, food $1,931. AM: fun morning with Heather; 11am cocktail pop was a bit tricky with light bar training but guests kept happy; only 2 IRDs. PM: smooth evening with appropriate cuts and great guest engagement. Garden: slow, steady, friendly faces — Nik styled out the Garden, Rhianna stopped by; cucumber collins needed for Thursday. Kitchen very slow; Dante left early. Favorite: the cheese plate w/ grilled chicken is fire, plus meaningful FOH check-ins.

venues.name: D&C East Village
venues.narrative: **EV Sunday 8/30 — MOD: Kyler & team.** Net sales $2,537 vs target $3,757 (-32.5%). 91 guests, $28 check avg, comps $91.85 (over half for the No. 3 and a Macallan rep in from LA). Food $32, beverage $2,505. Ridiculously slow night — full bar never materialized, rail unused, several tables single-turn. Ella seated smartly to give an impression of fullness. Sticky, sleepy Sunday at the door; near-capacity only around 9pm, no waitlist — folks resting up for Labor Day weekend. A visitor from the Netherlands who owns the books, and sales rep Sam boosted the vibes. 89 covers, 3 solos, no large parties. Top seller: Native Lion (broad spread on a slow night). Back Catalog Banger: Trust Fall. No-show: 2-top at 9pm, not charged. Kitchen: some stays shortened by lack of food.

venues.name: D&C Los Angeles
venues.weather: Another warm night in the city
venues.narrative: **LA Sunday 8/30 — MOD: Joe + Josh + Oscar.** Net sales $4,581 vs target $4,758 (-3.7%). 126 guests, $86.44 check avg, comps $113 (Davey, Francisco, Rafael, investor, birthday, DNL). Food $928, Standing Room $0. Steady Sunday — opened with 40 covers and a mellow first couple hours; biggest push 8-9:30pm when the waitlist hit almost 30, but the team burned and turned to seat everyone in a timely fashion. Sleepy last hour with familiar industry faces stopping by post-work. A smooth ending to a very busy weekend. No-shows charged.

venues.name: D&C Washington DC
venues.narrative: **DC Sunday 8/30 — MOD: Marcus.** Total net sales incl. events $1,986.93 vs target $1,869 (+6.3%). Marquee bar $2,185.64, Garden $0, food $227.50. 45 guests (35 walk-in / 20 reso), $43.19 guest avg, comps $19.42 (investor + celebration bubbles). Easy Sunday, no major pops; host cut at 8pm just as heavy rain and lightning killed alley foot traffic. Alex and Ian ran a fun bar top with industry love; Jordan's friends had a great night. Last call 9:30pm. Maintenance: garbage disposal out of order; ice machines looked at but may need another visit; curtain track needs replacing soon. (Two form submissions came in; used the later corrected entry.)

venues.name: Municipal Grand F&B
venues.narrative: **MG Sunday 8/30 — AM MOD: Sam/Justin & Lex; PM MOD: Braden & Marcus.** Total net sales $5,880 vs target $6,000 (-2.0%). Municipal Bar AM $3,889 (147 guests), PM $4,227 (27 guests), Sun Club $382, Hot Eye $1,210, food $1,727, comps $297. Typical slow Sunday breakfast (rain plus no alcohol until 11am); 11-12 was the busiest hour. Evening dreadfully slow — cut to 2 servers early and knocked out cleaning projects. Sun Club light and steady. Hot Eye: long lull until 11:30pm, then a big service-industry crew rolled in with Kelwin back in town for a show — all of the room's sales came in that final hour. Kitchen: very slow; stuffed peppers finally 86'd. Favorite: Carla Davis and her mom Rhonda in as guests, plus MG staff hanging in THE post-show.

venues.name: D&C Seattle
venues.narrative: **SEA — Sunday 8/30.** Pre-opening; no service and no EON report expected (soft opening 8/28, F&F nights 8/31–9/1). Not an outstanding report.
